idea: Development land sourcing and appraisal for HNW buyers
buyer: HNW individuals wanting to develop property
pain: They want to develop but cannot judge sites or numbers
v1: Source and appraise three sites for one client
verdict: High fees per client, but HNW clients are episodic and the work is deeply bespoke.

why.distribution: Reachable via her husband's professional network, one introduction at a time.
why.demand: HNW buyers do pay advisors for development guidance.
why.fmf: Site judgement plus development appraisal is exactly her two-career combination.
why.revenue_structure: One engagement per client, occasionally repeating.
why.defensibility: Trust-based and personal; buying agents compete.
why.leverage: Entirely bespoke, heavy on her time and site visits.
why.ceiling: £17k x 12 clients = £204k, but twelve HNW development clients in a year is far beyond introduction volume.

ceiling_arithmetic: £17k x 12 clients = £204k. Twelve HNW development clients requires an introduction rate her network cannot produce. Realistic: 2-3 = £34-51k.
carries: High fees, genuine two-domain fit, and clients who value judgement over price.
kills: Client volume. HNW development clients arrive at a rate of a few a year through introductions.
test: Ask her husband for two introductions to HNW clients considering development.
test_pass: One engages for a paid appraisal.
